verdict.rationale: Persona's docs confirm liveness checks and a Selfie Verification that asks whether the individual is present during the transaction. The docs also say it is especially useful when combined with a Government ID Verification, which implies matching the selfie to the ID document. They do not explicitly describe face-to-portrait matching or name any defenses against presentation attacks. Missing for 10: explicit documentation of selfie-to-document portrait face matching; documented defenses against printed photos, screens, and replayed video; any independent or hands-on corroboration of liveness efficacy.
